methods: Three whole paired runs per duration; all paired points including failed/missing/N/A remain visible.
Common UART recovery may retain the old relay; new-relay handover and its <=4s target are separate.
Counts after RFend or a fresh old-channel echo are potentially unnecessary changes, not an oracle judgment or a promised policy benefit.
No-recovery remains censored. Actual times >4s are retained; by4s failure includes observed no-recovery past4s.
Actual phases use logged host timestamps and separately labelled source/ns3 times; no nominal modulo phase is invented.
Three-pair percentile intervals are exploratory; a degenerate count interval is not a reliability/equivalence guarantee.
Do not pool old30 with new18 or average the three duration factors into one policy effect.

analysis.censoring: right-censored time is never substituted as a successful recovery
analysis.completion_gap: last pre-fault completed goal to first eligible new goal completion
analysis.goal_decomposition: critical last-finishing UAV under one assigned relay/epoch; first goal CID and latest completion-refresh CID are distinct explicit lineages; no continuous authority inferred
analysis.goal_delivery_subphases: goal creation to first command creation includes refresh scheduling and issuer/authority availability; first command creation to UART is application delivery including processing/relay, not pure RF latency
analysis.goal_recovery: new postfault goal, target changed >=1m from last pre-fault admitted target, observed maneuver and dwell; not latest refresh creation
analysis.group_recovery: first postfault-created refresh admitted to every member under one leader/epoch
analysis.latency_clock: host monotonic; command creation to actual UART write end; send-event latency reported separately
analysis.offered_denominator: all unique offered refresh requests, including unsent
analysis.restricted_loss: min(time to first recovery, 30.0s); a bounded loss, not an imputed recovery; missing if horizon not observed
analysis.sent_denominator: all unique target-bearing GCS sends, including lost/late; timely requires verified lease/payload lineage and complete application relay chain
analysis.total_GCS: renewals before failure detection can be issued but lost; new leader selection must remain absent
analysis.two_hop_evidence: application stage lineage; native PHY/PCAP proof remains a separate requirement
